# Invoice splitting

## problem

Finance cannot split a single payment across two invoices.

## requirements

A payment may be applied across invoices at the point it is recorded. The reconciliation queue is empty at the end of a working day.

# Invoice splitting

## Problem

Finance reconciles invoices **by hand** when one payment covers two invoices.

## Scope

Splitting a single payment across up to five invoices.
